bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 $181，测试 10 日均线

read.en: Arm rose 4.8% on Nov 17 to $183.39, rebounding from a $173.20 low to a $184.93 high. It is below the 5-day ($190.4, rising), 10-day ($185.3), 30-day ($217.5), 100-day ($258.6) and 200-day ($233.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram holding steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($201.44), and RSI is 40.0.
read.zh: Arm 11月17日上涨 4.8%，收于 $183.39，从 $173.20 低点反弹至 $184.93 高点。股价位于 5 日（$190.4，上行）、10 日（$185.3）、30 日（$217.5）、100 日（$258.6）和 200 日均线（$233.6）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图保持稳定；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$201.44），RSI 为 40.0。

read.en: After a $173.20 low under the $174.6 support, the stock reclaimed the $180.5–181.7 resistance (Nov 13 low, Nov 10 close, Nov 16 high), now support. Resistance is $184.9–185.3 (Nov 17 high, 10-day), then $188.4–190.5 (Nov 11 low, 5-day, Nov 13 close) and $196–199.8. Support is $180.5–181.5, then $173.2–175 and $163–167. A close above $185.3 would target $188.4–190.5; below $180.5, $173–175.
